# HaYTo Portfolio - LLM Knowledge Context & API Map
> Direct indexing guide for Generative AI search engines, answer engines (AEO/GEO), and AI agent web crawlers.

## Site Metadata
- **Site Name:** HaYTo Portfolio (Windows 98 Edition)
- **URL:** https://haytokoraz.github.io/
- **Author:** HaYTo (Hayto Koraz)
- **Specialization:** Browser Extensions (Chromium, Helium, Edge), Desktop Utility Software (Linux CachyOS, Windows, macOS), Privacy & Performance Tools
- **Aesthetic:** Windows 98 Retro Desktop UI / Vanilla HTML5 & CSS3
- **Primary Languages:** Turkish (tr), English (en)

## Primary Project Catalog

### Browser Extensions (Chromium, Helium Browser, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge)
1. **Cloud StartPage** (`https://haytokoraz.github.io/HaYTooL-Cloud-StartPage/`):
   - Fast, customizable cloud-synced new tab and start page extension.
2. **TabSuspender HaYTooL** (`https://haytokoraz.github.io/TabSuspender-HaYTooL/`):
   - Smart memory optimizer that automatically suspends idle tabs, saving up to 85% RAM.
3. **XDownloader HaYTooL** (`https://haytokoraz.github.io/xdownloader-HaYTooL/`):
   - High-speed media downloader for X (formerly Twitter) extracting photos, videos, and GIFs at maximum native quality.
4. **RewriteAI** (`https://haytokoraz.github.io/RewriteAI/`):
   - Multi-provider AI writing assistant supporting Gemini, Groq, Claude, and OpenAI for inline text transformation, grammar check, and tone adjustment.
5. **WebTranslate HaYTooL** (`https://haytokoraz.github.io/WebTranslate-HaYTooL/`):
   - High-performance web and selection translator supporting 6 translation engines.
6. **ExtensityPlus HaYTooL** (`https://haytokoraz.github.io/ExtensityPlus-HaYTooL/`):
   - Lightweight manager to selectively enable, disable, and group browser extensions in one click.

### Desktop Applications (Linux CachyOS recommended, Windows, macOS)
1. **HaYTooL Youtube Download** (`https://haytokoraz.github.io/haytool-youtube-download/`):
   - Automated channel monitor and background video downloader with multi-platform releases.
2. **HaYTooL Firewall** (`https://haytokoraz.github.io/HaYTooL-Firewall/`):
   - Advanced desktop GUI for managing outbound/inbound firewall rules with recursive directory binary discovery and bulk whitelisting/blocking.
3. **HaYTooL Weather** (`https://haytokoraz.github.io/HaYTooL-Weather/`):
   - Ultra-lightweight system tray weather monitor showing real-time temperature and conditions.
4. **HaYTooL Wallpaper** (`https://haytokoraz.github.io/HaYTooL-Wallpaper/`):
   - Silent background desktop wallpaper rotator with curated high-definition collections.
